items.text: Hi everyone! It's been while! I hope you're all having a wonderful day. With the craziness of the Steam Summer Sale and recently finishing college, I decided to take a small bit of time to relax and reset my brain. But, now we're back at it :)
I know it goes without saying, but thank you to everyone for all the endless support you give us. It means the world. <3
-Brandon
[*WARNING: SPOILERS AHEAD*]
Okay, so here are some of the recent changes we've added to Buddy Simulator 1984:
Can now toggle windowed mode with Alt+Enter.
Save is no longer corrupted if game crashes during Isla transition.
Fixed quite a few typos I'm too embarrassed to mention.
Phoney no longer locks you inside their house after "pinecone" quest.
Can no longer hide from Tiny Joey behind a palm tree. You can never hide from Tiny Joey.
Tortley will no longer accidentally initiate final quest instead of his "water the flowers" quest.
Buddy no longer exclaims about killing the Snoodlewonker when you should be going to bed instead.
Moved Rudy's junk pile to prevent player from being stuck.
Morton can no longer be placed in front of doorways and important gate entrances.
Tom has a birthday now according to Numbly. Poor Tom :(
Quite a few tiny ones that I never wrote down. Oops.

Hey friends! Sorry this update took so long to get out. I just started my final semester of school, so I've been a tad busy. But lucky for you guys, this patch has fixed our final consistent bug... at least out of the ones we know... unless I created more in this patch.
Fingers crossed, heh.
-Brandon
[*WARNING: SPOILERS AHEAD*]
So there's probably some extra tiny things that haven't been added to this list, but here are the main ones:
The infamous Groncho "walking loop" bug has been fixed! [It turns out only people with Turkish devices ran into this bug. We got you Turkish friends!]
Holding backspace on input box is no longer fidgety.
Eyes no longer flicker to black when blinking.
Added flavor text for crushed Bean child.
Added rimshot sounds to Crank in 2.5D.
Cannot talk to Crank from the front in Toot's Tavern
Fixed sink and oven interaction colliders to be easier to use.
Added more trees during "ending 2" forest sequence.
Can no longer stand on short party members "ending 2" forest sequence.
Walking left from pet in tunnel no longer causes buggy animation.
Added Tortley portrait to Tortley's dialouge during the scene.
Chase scene during "ending 3" no longer breaks if caught right after final door.
Tweaked band animations slightly to avoid sliding.
No music plays in Bean's house if you stole the Can of Pears. You don't deserve it.
Slightly tweaked Grin's Wingman animations to perform damage in-time with a wink.
Can no longer double slash during... the scene.
Quitting before the color shifts no longer shows a colored message box.
Fixed game soft lock when party member dies of the Stinky debuff.
This update is just a whole lot of bugs! They would have been done yesterday but I sort of, uh, needed a mental health day. Releasing an indie game during college midterms has kept me a bit busy :P
Anyways, there have been a LOT of little bugs squashed today, but these were the big ones:
- "drawers" is now a possible noun replacement for "cabinet" below the shed.
- Added missing collider on the turning dock lever puzzle.
- Joey no longer leaves his stretched arms after a game over.
- Player is now frozen upon loading into a 2.5D save.
- Fixed common black-screen bug on loading save.
- August 30th is now recognized as a birthday... sorry about that!
- Will no longer defy gravity on stairs during the ending hand sequence.
- Slowed down player during some Palchumville dialouge moments to prevent trigger skipping.
- Player can no longer get stuck behind the boardwalk stands (Waxed Wick, etc.)
- Pause disabled when naming your first move.
- The player no longer gets knocked back during catch. The ball also loses its velocity once close enough to the player.
- "Go back" is now a possible input for the hidden place.
- Can no longer give your friends infinite compliments.
- Fixed endless-walking Groncho during first fight... I think. I couldn't really recreate it in the first place, so let's hope for the best.
- Data resets no longer wipe Data collectable 'U'.
- Phoney no longer has the same "leave battle" dialouge as Morton.
- If player quits after placing THE sword in river, the sword will still be there upon return.
- Player slowed down during some dialouge sequences in Bluglands to prevent early Rebus initiation.
- Can now interact with Ella during hallway moment.
- Captain Chunk's fight no longer appears after they are befriended.
- Can no longer pause during the credits sequence.
-Brandon <3
Important bugs related to move speed and music playing have been fixed!
- Player is now slowed down during bad place moments to avoid dialogue skipping.
- Player was also slowed down during left tunnel dialogue.
- The happy town music no longer plays during uh, certain places.
- Foot tap no longer continues playing after... stuff happens.
-Added a new Settings Menu to 2D and 2.5D where you can....
-Change music and world volume to make your ears happy! [Note: These changes haven't been applied to the endings just yet, but we're planning it.]
-Change scanlines and bloom intensity to cure your headaches!

-Toggle "One Key Mode", a new mode for those who find difficulty in combat! An explanation for this mechanic is given in-game.: Note: We still have more plans for extra accessibility in the future. We want this game to be as inclusive and accessible to as many people as we can. :)
-Increased movement speed! Roller skates are more speedy now too hehe.
-Perfect block time has been increased!
-Leap year birthdays don't crash the game anymore, we got you leap year friends!
-Lardo doesn't soft-lock anymore after giving them a random response.
-Party member colors now update in combat after heals.
-Colliders have been added to out-of-bounds areas in the Bluglands (How did we not know about those??).
-Added an obvious collider to the bedroom in 2.5D. (Again! How did we not know about this!?)
-Fixed Ginny text overlay bug. Thanks for the find space-mashers!
-Dejo bravisa no longer causes an endless screen-break if glitch moment starting.
-Your buddy still reacts to you finishing all quests even after starting the final quest.
-Dejo bravisa no longer causes a soft-lock when recruiting them.
-A fun new collision system now prevents collider skipping in 2.5D
-Force quitting after watering the flowers no longer causes a soft-lock.
-Added pauses to all important buddy dialogue in 2D.
-There's a lot of other little things, but I uh, didn't right them down. I did fix them though! For sure. Probably.

-More accessibility! We want to add more functionality for widescreen monitors and put more focus into hearing-impaired individuals who may struggle with some of the game's audio-based puzzles. We'd love to hear about any other ideas you all might have!
-We're going to continue to tweak and balance characters during combat, and pretty much anything battle related.

-BUGS BUGS BUGS BUGS Please keep us informed on the steam forums, in our Discord, or even just PM us on Twitter and tell us about anything you find! We love hearing all about the bugs you discover, and it always helps us to make the game as good as we can make it.
You mean the world.
It's currently 4AM, so now I sleep.
G'night friends!
-Brandon <3
